correctness.rationale: The exact cross criterion follows from tensor adjacency; bipartite Koenig duality and matching size >=3 exhaust configurations. If matching number <=2 the two-row/two-column cover forces precisely two selected cells on each line; converses check deletion minimality. The four-cell overlap is exactly a 2x2 rectangle. The polynomial follows by inclusion-exclusion. The smallest disconnected case is covered. Independent brute enumeration by original graph definition agrees for 9 parameter pairs.

originality.rationale: Kazemi proves an upper-number special case for a factor of order two and asks about arbitrary factors; the present theorem handles the k=1 case in every dimension and uniquely enumerates all inclusion-minimal total dominating sets. Burcroff–O’Brien Section 5.1 studies ordinary domination-polynomial unimodality, and Bahadır–Ekim–Gözüpek study general WTD structure; none of their inspected statements imply the exact family classification. Targeted literature and database searches found no stronger or identical result, subject to publication-priority risk.
residual_risks: Search engines, indexed records and visible full-text sources are not a complete literature census; an equivalent result could occur in an unindexed table or differently termed cross-family paper.

value.rationale: A natural two-parameter family receives a complete, explicit inclusion-minimal total-domination distribution. The upper number equals four for all factors, extending Kazemi’s known K_n tensor K2 case to the k=1 question for arbitrary factors. The exact minimum-size phase transition and well-totally-dominated classification follow, with motivations in product domination and minimal-set enumeration.
